AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

4. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

5. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

8. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.

9. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.

10. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

11. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

12. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hangar Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Information and Communication Technology

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.

6. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. A — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.

9. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hangar Safety; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aircraft Structures; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aircraft Propulsion; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
